address: 22B Phung Khac Khoan Street, Da Kao Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, 700000, Vietnam
bio: Food and fashion are the passions of many tastemakers. This café annexed to a two-storey clothing store seamlessly melds the two under one roof. With only two tables indoors, most seating is al fresco. The food is essentially Gallic with Vietnamese twists. Local tropical fruits and nuts are generously used in the sauces and seasoning, while soigné plating pays tribute to fine French dining. Lunch set menus offer great value....
